findings: All 7 specialist agents (zeko, cto, cfo, kai, somad, badsector, nova) have finalized, mutually consistent Phase 1A artifacts: AGENT.md role contracts, policy.yaml declarative policies, and agent.cordis.yml preset drafts, all version-pinned to DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1-rc.2.

The least-privilege capability architecture is correctly realized across three layers (permissions.yaml matrix, per-role policy.yaml, role-preset-mapping.yaml toolFilter): read-only roles (cfo, kai, badsector) deny bash/edit/write, badsector has no execution path and never authorizes, subdelegation is DENY BY DEFAULT for all specialists, and only the orchestrator holds delegation tools.

The 7 agent.cordis.yml presets and config/tool-subagent-instances.yaml are DRAFT and NOT mounted (mount_required: false, ADR Decision 4/7 is HUMAN_PENDING), so the role contracts are specification-complete but not yet deployed as DSH Agent Presets/tool-subagent instances.
